vol_rle_centroid — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: rle_region → position

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_rle_centroid(region, spacing=None) (to call the implementation directly, import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_centroid(region, spacing=None); from the registry, ops3d.get("vol_rle_centroid"))

Usage

Centroid (z, y, x) of the region, computed on the runs (no decode).

Each run contributes n voxels at its row's (z, y) and mean x (start + end - 1) / 2 — the exact arithmetic mean of the member voxel indices, so it matches the dense centroid to floating-point accuracy. Pass *spacing* (sz, sy, sx) for physical coordinates. An empty region raises ValueError.

Returns: 3 float values (z, y, x) (in depth, row, col order). Without spacing they are in voxel index units (the arithmetic mean of the indices itself); passing spacing multiplies each component by (sz, sy, sx) to give physical coordinates (mm etc., the same unit as spacing). spacing is either positive finite values of length 3, or a volio.VolumeMeta with a spacing_mm attribute.

Validation (ValueError): VolRLE consistency check / 0 runs / spacing not of length 3, non-positive, or non-finite.

Note: this is not the centre of mass but the geometric centroid of the voxels (all voxels equally weighted). If you want a centroid weighted by gray values, vol_rle_decode and compute it yourself.
